collection.description: Two elders who have known each other for years wonder whether to become partners.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder1) and (elder2), two elders who have known each other for years, wonder whether to become partners.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They begin a joyful late-life romance.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One elder prefers their cherished friendship, and both remain kind.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They discover how much companionship they still have to offer.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They enjoy the walk but choose to remain independent.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They find compatible wishes for their remaining years.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They realize their daily habits would make partnership difficult.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Their friendship becomes an affectionate partnership over time.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They keep their separate homes and treasure regular visits.
